title: vibe-template stack registry
description: Framework-first registry. Every entry is DATA — adding a framework must never require a code change. Validated by scripts/tests/stacks.test.mjs, so a malformed entry turns `npm run gate` red.

signal.description: One detection probe. Exactly one key.

file.description: Repo-relative path; `*` is allowed in the LAST segment only (e.g. `next.config.*`, `*.csproj`).

content.description: [path, substring] — path may glob its last segment; matches when the file contains the substring.

command.description: A gate command: one shell line, an ordered list of them, or ""/null to declare the gate deliberately absent.

tier.description: `framework` entries outrank `language` entries when both match.

extends.description: Base stack id(s) to inherit gates/ignore/conventions from.

verified.description: false = commands are best-effort. docs/STACK.md then carries a visible 'verify before trusting' banner instead of pretending confidence.

detect.description: Detection signals. Ties are broken alphabetically, so AN ENTRY FOR A FRAMEWORK BUILT ON ANOTHER MUST CARRY MORE SIGNALS THAN THE ONE IT IS BUILT ON. Verified the hard way: Wails vendors labstack/echo and was detected as Echo; an Ionic Angular app was detected as Angular; the official Leptos starter was detected as Axum. Each was fixed by adding the marker that is definitive for the specific framework (wails.json, @capacitor/core, [package.metadata.leptos]).

weight.description: Optional tie-breaker added to the matched-signal count when ranking.

coreLayer.description: Where heavy logic belongs in THIS framework — fills the 'Core-first' rule in AGENTS.md.

versionTargets.description: Documentation only. scripts/version.mjs detects targets itself and never reads this file.
